##### Project General Facts

Marea, with interiors by Missoni, is a residential development by DarGlobal comprising four low-rise blocks, each configured with a basement, ground level, and two upper floors. The collection offers two, three, and four-bedroom apartments finished in a contemporary Mediterranean style, defined by minimalist lines, simplicity of form, and natural materials. The project is set within a gated community with a private entrance, positioned as a refined, design-led residential offering.

The development includes a landscaped community garden, dedicated indoor and outdoor areas for children, a swimming pool with a children's splash area, and an infinity pool. Residents also have access to a state-of-the-art gym and a tennis court. The gated community is complemented by a private entrance and round-the-clock premium security services.

Interiors, styled with Missoni-inspired accents throughout, feature ceiling heights of three metres, porcelain flooring in living and kitchen areas, and porcelain wood-effect flooring in bedrooms, with suspended gypsum ceilings and waterproof plasterboard in wet areas. Kitchens are fitted with solid-surface countertops, lacquered or laminate joinery, and Siemens or equivalent appliances including a fridge, oven, hob, hood, and washing machine, while bathrooms feature Porcelanosa and Duravit sanitary fixtures with Missoni-inspired mirrors in the powder room. Each block is served by its own elevators, and two-bedroom units include one parking space with storage, while three- and four-bedroom units include two parking spaces with storage. The residences are delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Cortesin in Casares is one of the most refined and exclusive residential destinations on the Costa del Sol, known for its privacy, elegance, and world-class lifestyle. Located between Estepona and Sotogrande, the area offers a peaceful setting surrounded by rolling hills, lush landscapes, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea. It is defined by low-density development and a sense of tranquility that makes it ideal for luxury living.

At the heart of the area is the renowned Finca Cortesin, a landmark destination that elevates the entire location with its championship golf course, five-star hotel, spa, and fine dining experiences. The presence of such a prestigious resort creates a unique atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity, attracting high-end investors and residents seeking a resort-style lifestyle.

Despite its serene environment, Cortesin enjoys excellent connectivity to key destinations across the coast, including Marbella and Gibraltar. Residents benefit from close proximity to pristine beaches, marinas, international schools, and leisure attractions, while enjoying a quiet, secure, and nature-oriented setting that defines the essence of upscale Costa del Sol living.
